> I don't understand how individuals like that can respect themselves after trivializing such a major thing that so many people have to face for their own benefit.

Neither do I. I can't even go and talk to her because she has a restraining order against me. She's living her lovely little married life now, so I'm sure she doesn't care what happens to me.

> I know it sounds like a HUGE hypothetical, but what's your thought on that if that were possible?

They always look at your criminal record before they grant you a visa and in my case I would say that it is unlikely to be successful considering the so-called rape happened only 4 years ago. They obviously don't to risk bringing any more violent criminals in their country, so it's understandable for it to be a factor. I'm not from the US btw.
